first_run_caveat: review-first had four fixture-induced subtest failures from existing HTTP 5xx retry and bounded schema correction; corrected fixture evidence preserves only the eight reproduced product failures. Original record retained.

resolved.finding: Malformed HTTP 400/404/422 bodies in both adapters were misclassified as unsupported tools and produced a plain completion.
resolved.verification: Malformed and generic argument errors now yield one request and controlled delivery; explicit unsupported-tools messages retain fallback compatibility.

resolved.finding: Anthropic HTTP error.message string or object was stringified into core.error UI, including synthetic Traceback.
resolved.verification: Fixed host diagnostics; raw body never displayed.

resolved.finding: A user-role/non-message response containing a valid tool_use could create a synthetic pending ticket.
resolved.verification: Explicit role/type validated; omitted legacy envelope and assistant/message normal forms remain supported.

resolved.finding: An escaped unpaired surrogate could fail observer UTF-8 evidence save before reaching the actual parser.
resolved.verification: Exact ObservedProvider class, real Provider parser and handle_chat test retain raw bytes for controlled protocol error and save only error type/hash.

resolved.finding: Synchronous error-response close after a timed-out read could wait on a reader lock on the event loop.
resolved.verification: Read and close now both run in the worker under bounded caller wait; confirmed by source review.

compatibility: OpenAI first-choice strategy retained; later choices are alternatives, not a merged tool batch.

Empty content with zero-argument object tool call executes once.
Mixed malformed tool batches in either order create no tickets or effects.
Schema-invalid tail beyond call budget blocks entire front batch.
Successful, failed and unknown action receipts survive malformed supplementary responses without replay.
Provider runner adds one normal-chat and one existing short-file sequence; old scenarios and permission/task schemas unchanged.
limits: No live models or external business were called by reviewer; DS/GLM compatibility belongs to parent validation.
